name: playwright-flow-recorder
description: Record a browser walkthrough as a semantic event stream (JSONL) — multiple candidate selectors, recorded assertions, and intent notes — then let an AI agent convert it into tests that reuse your existing step library.
author: Rakesh Barik

scripts.test: node test/config-test.js && node test/smoke-test.js && node test/focus-trap-test.js && node test/widget-mount-test.js
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
